correctness.rationale: Same-part vertex pairs are the only nonadjacent pairs. Such a pair is visible with respect to X exactly when the complement of X contains a vertex outside its part. The ordinary, outer, and dual pair requirements activate this condition under exactly the cases used in the proof, giving the complement classifications and disjoint invalid-complement counts. The direct shortest-path checker confirms the theorem on all 87 complete multipartite isomorphism types of orders 2 through 9.

value.rationale: Visibility polynomials encode every feasible set size, not only the maximum. The theorem gives exact all-set classifications and closed coefficient formulas for three visibility variants on arbitrary complete multipartite graphs, strictly extending the published balanced complete-bipartite formulas and complementing the separately known total visibility polynomial.
